name: rev_1
formula: rank among members of: vadj_c[t]

name: rev_1_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked rev_1

name: rev_1_hl10
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 10 days) of ranked rev_1

name: rev_5
formula: rank among members of: mean of vadj_c over t-4..t (at least 3 values)

name: rev_5_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked rev_5

name: rev_5_hl10
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 10 days) of ranked rev_5

name: rev_21
formula: rank among members of: mean of vadj_c over t-20..t (at least 15 values)

name: rev_21_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked rev_21

name: rev_21_hl10
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 10 days) of ranked rev_21

name: mom_12_1
formula: rank among members of: sum of vadj_c over t-251..t-21 (all 231 values required)

name: vol_level
formula: rank among members of: log(sig[t]), sig = EWMA volatility, half-life 23 days

name: rev_5_sec
formula: rank among members of: rev_5 minus same-day mean of rev_5 among members of the same GICS sector

name: rev_5_sec_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked rev_5_sec

name: rev_5_sec_hl10
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 10 days) of ranked rev_5_sec

name: rev_21_sec
formula: rank among members of: rev_21 minus same-day sector mean among members

name: rev_21_sec_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked rev_21_sec

name: rev_21_sec_hl10
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 10 days) of ranked rev_21_sec

name: mom_12_1_sec
formula: rank among members of: mom_12_1 minus same-day sector mean among members

name: sent_bull
formula: rank among members of: mean bullish score of calendar days after the previous trading day and before t

name: sent_bull_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked sent_bull

name: sent_bull_hl21
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 21 days) of ranked sent_bull

name: sent_bear
formula: rank among members of: mean bearish score, same days as sent_bull

name: sent_bear_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked sent_bear

name: sent_bear_hl21
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 21 days) of ranked sent_bear

name: sent_net
formula: rank among members of: bullish minus bearish, same days

name: sent_net_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked sent_net

name: sent_net_hl21
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 21 days) of ranked sent_net

name: sent_act
formula: rank among members of: bullish plus bearish, same days

name: sent_act_hl5
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 5 days) of ranked sent_act

name: sent_act_hl21
formula: EWMA over time (half-life 21 days) of ranked sent_act

name: sent_flag
formula: 1 if a member has any sentiment usable at t, else 0 (not ranked)
